title: LED Lights for Domestic and Similar General Lighting Purposes — Safety Requirements
scope: This standard specifies safety requirements for LED lamps and LED modules used for general lighting purposes with supply voltages not exceeding 250V.
text: IS 16102: LED Lights for Domestic and Similar General Lighting Purposes. Scope: Safety requirements for LED lamps and modules. Committee: ETD 33. Year: 2012. Scheme: CRS (Compulsory Registration Scheme). Mandatory under QCO (Electronics and IT Goods). Applies to LED lamps with supply voltage ≤250V used for general lighting. Manufacturers must register under CRS before selling in India.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100V
scope: PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100V for use in domestic wiring and other installations.
text: IS 694: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100V. Scope: Domestic wiring cables, PVC insulated. Committee: ETD 05. Year: 2010. Scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I). Mandatory under QCO. Required for all PVC insulated wires sold in India for domestic wiring applications.

title: Portland Cement — Ordinary and Rapid Hardening — Specification
scope: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) used in construction.
text: IS 1444: Portland Cement (Ordinary and Rapid Hardening). Scope: OPC for general construction use. Committee: CED 02. Scheme: ISI Mark (mandatory). This is one of the most commonly certified products in India. Required for all cement manufactured and sold in India.

title: Automotive Vehicles — Rear-view Mirror (Planar) — Specification
scope: Planar rear-view mirrors for automotive vehicles.
text: IS 2296: Rear-view mirrors for automotive vehicles. Voluntary certification. Committee: TED 02.

title: Protective Helmets for Scooter and Motorcycle Riders — Specification
scope: Helmets providing head protection for riders of two-wheelers (scooters and motorcycles).
text: IS 4151: Protective Helmets for Scooter and Motorcycle Riders. Committee: PGD 07 (note: filed under fire-fighting/PPE sectional committee, not a PPE-named committee — verify mapping). Scheme: ISI Mark (mandatory under QCO). Mandatory for all two-wheeler helmets sold in India. Common rejection cause: wrong test impact energy levels in application.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances
scope: General safety requirements for household electrical appliances including irons, kettles, toasters, fans.
text: IS 302: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances. General requirements. Committee: ETD 29. Voluntary for most; mandatory for selected appliances under QCO.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250V and Rated Current up to and Including 16A
scope: Plugs, sockets and socket-outlets for domestic and similar use.
text: IS 1293: Plugs and Socket-Outlets (250V, 16A). Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: ETD 07. All plugs and sockets sold in India must carry ISI mark under QCO. Common in households and commercial installations.

title: Electric Ceiling Fans and Regulators
scope: Ceiling fans with built-in capacitor-run motors for domestic use, including speed regulators.
text: IS 374: Electric Ceiling Fans and Regulators. Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: ETD 29. Covers ceiling fans for household use. Mandatory under QCO. Also includes exhaust fans under related standard IS 2312.

title: Code of Practice for Unfired Pressure Vessels
scope: Design, manufacture, inspection and testing of unfired pressure vessels including pressure cookers.
text: IS 2825 and IS 2347: Pressure cookers. Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: MED 09. Pressure cookers with 1-25 litre capacity must have ISI mark. One of the most scrutinized categories due to safety incidents. Document checklist includes test reports for pressure test, valve test, gasket test.

title: Toys — Safety for Children
scope: Safety requirements for toys intended for children under 14 years. Electrical toys covered under separate ETD committee standard.
text: IS 9844: Toys Safety for Children. Committee: CHD 10 (note: electrical toys under ETD committee). Mandatory CRS registration. All toys sold in India must meet IS 9844. QCO: Toys (Quality Control) Order. Note: electric toys sit under electrical appliances committee ETD, not toys committee — verify mapping before filing.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — General Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for IT equipment including computers, printers, monitors and similar equipment.
text: IS 13252: IT Equipment Safety. Mandatory CRS registration for all IT equipment sold in India. Committee: LITD 14. Covers PCs, laptops, printers, UPS, power supplies. CRS registration required before import/manufacture.

title: AC and/or DC Sensitive Type Residual Current Operated Circuit-Breakers with and without Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Uses (RCCBs/RCBOs)
scope: RCCBs and RCBOs for household electrical protection.
text: IS 16444: RCCBs/RCBOs. Voluntary certification. Committee: ETD 20.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — Working Voltages up to 1100V
scope: Heavy duty PVC cables for industrial use up to 1100V.
text: IS 1554: Heavy Duty PVC Insulated Cables. Voluntary. Committee: ETD 05. Industrial applications.

title: Mobile Phones — Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for mobile handsets and smartphones.
text: IS 14712: Mobile Phone Safety. Mandatory CRS registration. Committee: LITD 14. All mobile phones sold in India (including imports) must register under CRS. Registration must be done before import.

title: Concentrations of Antifreeze for Internal Combustion Engines — Specification
scope: Antifreeze for automotive engines.
text: IS 9103: Antifreeze concentrations. Voluntary certification.

title: Road Vehicles — Vehicle Alarm Systems — Specification
scope: Vehicle alarm and immobilizer systems.
text: IS 16046: Vehicle Alarm Systems. Voluntary. Committee: TED 14.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B
scope: Standard fasteners — bolts, screws, nuts.
text: IS 1363: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts. Voluntary certification. Committee: MED 14.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Structural steel for use in buildings, bridges and general structural work.
text: IS 2062: Hot Rolled Structural Steel. Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: MTD 04. Required for structural steel used in construction. Also related: IS 1786 for TMT bars (reinforcement). Both mandatory under QCO.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: TMT bars and deformed steel bars for concrete reinforcement.
text: IS 1786: TMT Bars / High Strength Deformed Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement. Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: MTD 04. All TMT bars sold in India must be ISI marked. Very high enforcement — non-ISI TMT bars face market seizure. Related to IS 2062.

title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords
scope: Copper and aluminium conductors used in insulated cables.
text: IS 8130: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables. Voluntary. Committee: ETD 05. Specifies conductor materials (copper/aluminium) for insulated cables.

title: EV Charging Station — AC and DC Charging — Specification
scope: EV charging stations including AC slow charging and DC fast charging equipment.
text: IS 16900: EV Charging Stations (AC and DC). Mandatory ISI certification. Committee: ETD 53. All EV chargers installed in India must comply. Covers Bharat AC-001 and Bharat DC-001 standards. Growing category with increasing enforcement.
